title: SmartReco Course v1.0
description: One curated course. See data/COURSE_SCHEMA.md for the curation rules this schema cannot express (paraphrase-only overview, objective corroboration, module-group clustering, stale-date handling).

slug.description: Stable identity. Must equal the filename stem. Ladder edges reference it, so it is effectively immutable after ingest.

title.description: Verbatim from source — the one field copied exactly.

overview.description: PARAPHRASED, 2-4 sentences. Never sponsor marketing prose verbatim.

category.description: Exactly one primary. Drives the B3 diversity cap, so a wrong bucket distorts the whole rec set.

level.description: The fusion-match anchor (0.15*level_match in confidence). Exactly one value, even for wide-span courses.

level_range.description: [min, max] for genuinely wide courses. Stored only — NOT scored in v2.3. `level` must still stand alone.

price.description: INR. null is legitimate for coupon-driven/volatile pricing and REQUIRES price_note. Null price is excluded from price-bounded retrieval filters.

price_note.description: Required when price is null. Quoted by the generate node in place of a number.

price_band.description: free=0, low=1-2999, mid=3000-9999, high>=10000 INR. When price is null this is estimated from the platform's typical range; record the basis in _comment_price.

is_free.description: Independent of price. Never inferred from it.

rating.description: null when not visible at the source. Never guess — the validator's null warning is expected behaviour.

format.description: Delivery + freshness block. Read by app/catalog/freshness.py. NEVER embedded (Tier 3).

mode.description: live=scheduled cohort; hybrid=live + durable library; self-paced=always-on on-demand; recorded=replay of a FINISHED cohort.

cohort_start.description: FUTURE dates only. A past date here is the most dangerous defect in this schema — generate reads it as a live persuasion fact. Move passed cohorts to top-level cohort_start_stale.

schedule.description: Human-readable, with timezone. e.g. 'Sat & Sun, 20:00-23:00 IST'

duration_hours.description: Content hours for self-paced; null for live cohorts.

content_updated.description: Last real CURRICULUM revision, not last page edit. Leave null rather than guess — the scorer has defined unknown behaviour.

published_at.description: First release. Recency fallback when content_updated is unknown.

curriculum_version.description: Sponsors ship overlapping versions (3.0 page vs 2.0 PDF). Record which you curated, or null when the source publishes none — §7's null-with-a-comment rule applies.

cohort_start_stale.description: PAST cohorts only. Reference/recency input; excluded from generate context. Never rendered into copy.

objectives.description: Highest-value retrieval keys — one chunk each, phrased as user intent. CORROBORATION RULE: keep only objectives a real module supports; validate cites these back to users.

objectives_dropped.description: Published objectives with no supporting module. Retained as an audit trail; never embedded, never cited.

module_groups.description: 6-12 THEMATIC clusters, never one chunk per module: 3-word titles embed poorly and 28 vectors from one course starve the catalog out of RRF.

skills.description: Concrete named technologies/techniques, not adjectives. 8-25 is typical; there is deliberately NO maxItems — a 12-month four-category program legitimately carries 40+, and that is a judgment call for validate_seed.py to warn about (which it does above 30), not a structural error that blocks ingest.

career_roles.description: Card field only. Embedding these makes every course match every 'how do I become an X' query.

prereq_ids.description: Slugs. Must resolve at ingest (validate_graph fails loudly); forward refs are fine mid-curation.

related_ids.description: Carries similar AND alternative semantics — there are deliberately no similar_ids/bundle_ids arrays (arch C4).

source_urls.description: Use when syllabus and landing page differ; name the authoritative one in _comment_sources.

then.$comment: Null price without a price_note would leave the generate node with nothing to say about cost.

^_comment.description: Curation audit note. Stripped before embedding and before SQL write. Write one for every judgment call.
